classification: repeatability diagnostic for synthetic localhost transport; not network throughput
limitations: All scenarios use synthetic TCP loopback on a shared Codespaces host; no physical NIC, fabric, packet loss, or production peer authentication is measured.
Three brief repetitions are insufficient for a stable capacity claim or rigorous confidence interval; scheduling and host contention can dominate variability.
AI diagnostic trials use a randomly initialized model and are not product AI measurements.
CPU and RSS measurements are process-wide diagnostics, not dataplane-only resource use.

trial_policy.statistics: median, min/max, and population coefficient of variation across three runs; no confidence interval claimed
